english.note: Use 飛 as the all-purpose choice for travelling through the air or moving very fast, but not for piloting an aircraft.

examples.english: The kite can fly very high.
examples.jyutping: gaa3 zi2 jyun1 fei1 dak1 hou2 gou1

english.note: Use this colloquial verb when someone hurries or goes extremely fast, such as racing home or racing for the door.

examples.english: As soon as the bell rings, the students race out of the classroom.
examples.traditional: 落堂鐘一響，啲學生就飛出課室。
examples.jyutping: lok6 tong4 zung1 jat1 hoeng2 di1 hok6 saang1 zau6 fei1 ceot1 fo3 sat1
